project.name: Cinematic Technology Identity Video
project.purpose: Website cinematic motion system for a technology/software/AI personal brand

creative_direction.concept: Technology surrounds and amplifies the human, but the human remains at the center.

timeline.label: Initial human presence
timeline.description: Human subject appears in the high-tech environment. Establishes identity and premium technology context.

timeline.label: Human + interface / facial scan
timeline.description: Camera moves closer to the face while digital interfaces and a scanning effect reinforce technology without removing human presence.

timeline.label: Data transformation
timeline.description: Abstract data-wave transition connecting human identity to systems, software, SaaS and digital architecture.

timeline.label: Advanced helmet / AI technology
timeline.description: High-tech helmet sequence representing automation, AI agents, engineering and technological augmentation.

timeline.label: Helmet opening / human reveal
timeline.description: Mechanical opening reveals the human underneath; primary brand metaphor: technology assists, human remains central.

timeline.label: Final human hero frame
timeline.description: Final confident human presence in a premium technology environment. Suitable for final CTA or about section.

site_sections.title: Hero / First Fold
site_sections.behavior: autoplay muted playsInline, cinematic background, stop or fade before scene_03
site_sections.copy_role: Position software, SaaS, websites, landing pages and AI as professional solutions built around real business needs.

site_sections.title: Software / SaaS / Systems
site_sections.behavior: short looping visual or scroll-triggered playback
site_sections.copy_role: Show structure, systems thinking, integrations and digital architecture.

site_sections.title: AI / Automation / Agents
site_sections.behavior: play once on section enter; do not loop the reveal continuously
site_sections.copy_role: Communicate that AI and automation assist teams, reduce repetitive work and amplify human capability rather than replacing people.

site_sections.title: Human / About
site_sections.behavior: slow loop, freeze final frame, or use as poster image
site_sections.copy_role: Return the narrative from technology to the person behind the work.

web_implementation.recommended_strategy: Do not convert the video binary into JSON. Keep MP4/WebM assets as media files and use this JSON only as the timeline/configuration manifest.

performance.mobile_strategy: Use compressed clips or static poster for constrained devices; never load every full-resolution clip at page start.

antigravity_instructions.objective: Integrate the provided cinematic video into the existing website by section without changing the established visual identity, layout hierarchy or production-ready architecture.
steps: Inspect the current repository and identify the Hero, Software/SaaS, AI/Automation, About and CTA sections before changing anything.
Do not redesign the site globally. Preserve the current typography, spacing, colors, responsive behavior and component architecture.
Add the source video to the project's public/media or equivalent optimized asset directory.
Use this JSON manifest as the authoritative scene-to-section mapping.
Create reusable video/background media components instead of duplicating video logic in every section.
Prefer separate optimized clips for each section if build tooling permits; otherwise use the original MP4 and time-control playback programmatically.
Use IntersectionObserver to start/pause media when each section enters/leaves the viewport.
Do not play all section videos simultaneously.
Keep videos muted by default on the website unless the current design explicitly provides a user-controlled audio experience.
Add dark/gradient overlays only when necessary to preserve text legibility; never obscure the human face or key mechanical transformation.
Preserve mobile performance and provide posters/fallbacks.
Test desktop, tablet and mobile before finalizing.
Do not invent services, claims, integrations, metrics or functionality not already present in the site/project.
